title: Nvidia B300 GPU Rentals Hit New High After 17 Day Streak
summary:
Computing firms in the U.S. have shifted their pricing for top-tier hardware to a level not seen previously. Rental prices for Nvidia’s Blackwell Ultra (B300) GPUs rose for 17 consecutive days to reach a new all-time high on a Compute Desk index of verified transactions from U.S. neoclouds.

These specialized providers offer scalable compute capacity for artificial intelligence workloads. The sustained price increase for the B300 chips—the latest generation of Nvidia's hardware—indicates strong demand for high-performance computing resources among American cloud vendors.
